overall_notes: The paper primarily focuses on educational test generation rather than traditional NLG evaluation. Most automatic metrics are correlation-based statistical measures rather than standard NLG metrics like BLEU/ROUGE. The LLM-as-judge usage is limited to GPT-4 for safety filtering, not quality evaluation. Human evaluations are well-documented with clear experimental designs for comparing AI-generated vs human-generated test items.
